source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Provide wound care, tetanus vaccination, and TIG 250 IU IM because a dirty puncture wound plus unknown vaccination history requires active and passive prophylaxis.","B":"Provide wound care and tetanus vaccine without TIG because immune globulin is reserved for clean minor wounds with incomplete vaccination.","C":"Provide wound care and TIG without tetanus vaccine because passive antibody provides sufficient long-term protection after this exposure.","D":"Provide wound care and systemic antibiotics without tetanus vaccine or TIG because thorough wound treatment prevents tetanus by itself."}}
source_row.rationale: CDC classifies penetrating or puncture wounds as dirty/major wounds. For people with unknown vaccination history, tetanus vaccination is recommended for all wounds and TIG is indicated for dirty/major wounds; the prophylactic TIG dose is 250 IU IM.
source_row.source_detail: Recommendations > Vaccination recommended > For all wounds; TIG prophylaxis indications > For dirty or major wounds; Care > TIG dose 250 IU IM. source_row.stem: An adult with an unknown tetanus vaccination history has a deep puncture wound contaminated with soil. Which prophylaxis is indicated?
